handback.summary: Shared workflows now run Dokima's code from Dokima's repo, check the bot and key, and credit the bot by default.

criteria.812.1: Every job that runs Dokima checks out Dokima's own repo and runs only that code, never the repo's folder.
criteria.812.2: Each shared workflow can be called, and every job reading a key keeps the keys environment.
criteria.812.3: The agent run reads the key secret the settings name, from a runtime holding only the repo's settings.
criteria.812.4: A new early step fails the run, naming the app id, the app key and the keys environment.
criteria.812.5: A new step fails the run when the role's key secret is empty, naming it and the keys environment.
criteria.812.6: The default co-author names the bot itself; the run's commits and merges carry that line.
criteria.812.7: An empty co-author setting leaves the run's commits and merges with no line.
criteria.812.8: The adopter's file calls Dokima's entry workflow at a release tag.
criteria.812.9: The adopter's file is nineteen lines.
criteria.812.10: The adopter's file starts on every event; the entry workflow routes each to the right shared workflow.

raises.label: Old harnesses lack checkout
raises.text: These tests' runners never stand in for checking out Dokima's repo, so every job fails at that step. They need the stand-in the plan gave Machine.

raises.label: Copy step run alone
raises.text: These tests run the runtime copy step without the Dokima checkout before it, so it fails. Passing them means running the repo's own code, which 812.1 forbids.

raises.label: Repo code must run
raises.text: These tests put Dokima code in the repo's own folder and expect it to run, which 812.1 now forbids.
raises.evidence: `test_agents.py` 698.12 and 698.13 (a zeta adapter); `test_settings_test_setup.py` 794.8 (an old settings reader).

raises.label: Tests pin old design
raises.text: These tests demand the old triggers, text or paths, which the plan's call trigger, entry workflow and Dokima checkout change.

raises.label: Missing key now stops
raises.text: This test runs with a key secret the repo lacks and expects the agent to start; 812.5 now stops that run.
raises.evidence: `test_settings_setup.py::test_a_run_on_github_starts_the_model_the_agents_section_names` stops at the new key check, naming TEAM_KEY.

raises.label: No release tag yet
raises.text: Dokima has no release tag yet, so the tag the adopter's file names must be made before anyone installs it.
raises.evidence: `git ls-remote --tags origin` lists none; `dokima/install/dokima.yml` names v0.1.0.

raises.label: Wiki and logs credit
raises.text: The wiki sync writes the bot placeholder as it is, and commits on the logs branch credit no co-author.
raises.evidence: `.github/workflows/wiki.yml` uses CO_AUTHOR raw; `dokima/agent.py` save-record adds no trailer.
